proposal.reason: Primary change is in review/approval automation behavior owned by workflow: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds typed GraphQL fallback (withdraw_review_requests, pending_review_requests) with snapshot/history conflict checks for reviewer-withdrawal handling, and .github/scripts/maintainer_approval.py changes freshness gating to pr_number+head_sha+base_ref. .github/scripts/reviewer_api.py adds graphql() and GraphQLError to support that control flow. Evidence points to reviewer assignment/approval policy logic rather than CI execution or runtime library modules.
